_comment: Filled from .github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml (jobs backend-tests [3 path shards + shard guard, #321], backend-api, api-e2e and frontend, run in parallel on pull_request and on push to main). Keys are <job>:<step>; each command is the step's run line verbatim, prefixed with 'cd <working-directory> &&' and the step's env block where CI sets one. Steps run in order within a job (backend-tests:pytest is the union of the 3 shard selections, guarded by .github/scripts/backend-shard-guard.sh) and depend on the earlier setup steps (uv sync --locked, npm ci, Playwright/Nginx/age installs, blocklist provisioning).

commands.backend-api:blocklist-provision: cd backend && export APP_ENV=development DATABASE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/provisioning.sqlite3" PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5174 && export PASSWORD_BLOCKLIST_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/password-blocklist-ncsc.txt" && uv run --frozen python -m app.cli prepare-password-blocklist
commands.backend-api:lint: cd backend && uv run --frozen ruff check .
commands.backend-api:format: cd backend && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
commands.backend-api:age-backup-tests: cd backend && CI=true APP_ENV=test uv run --frozen pytest -m requires_age tests/test_backup_process.py tests/test_restore_process.py -ra
commands.backend-tests:pytest: cd backend && for s in tests/contracts "tests/test_[a-d]*.py" "tests/test_[e-z]*.py"; do APP_ENV=test uv run --frozen pytest $s || exit 1; done
commands.backend-api:dev-proxy-chain: cd backend && APP_ENV=test uv run --frozen pytest tests/integration/dev_proxy_chain.py -q
commands.backend-api:build-api: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run check:dist
commands.backend-api:nginx-static-serving: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e:api -- --nginx e2e-api/static-serving.spec.js
commands.backend-api:safe-logging-retention: cd backend && HEALTH_CHECKS_ENABLED=false APP_ENV=test uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_safe_logging.py tests/test_purge_expired.py -ra
commands.backend-api:service-units-migrations: cd backend && systemd-analyze --version && CI=true HEALTH_CHECKS_ENABLED=false APP_ENV=test uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_service_units.py tests/test_migration_lifecycle.py tests/test_health_worker_process.py -ra
commands.backend-api:nginx-functional: cd frontend && CI=true HEALTH_CHECKS_ENABLED=false npm run test:e2e:api -- --nginx-functional
commands.frontend:build-api: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run check:dist

critical_flows: Member registration and login (e2e-api/auth-register, auth-login, auth-login-return)
Edit and delete an own app entry (e2e-api/app-edit, app-delete)
Gallery browse, search and paging (e2e-api/gallery-query, gallery-paging, gallery-zero-result)
Admin approval and app management (e2e-api/admin-approval, admin-apps, admin-apps-manage)
Admin user management: password reset and user deletion (e2e-api/admin-password-reset, admin-user-delete)
Admin backups and Health Monitor (e2e-api/admin-backups, health-real)

unknowns: repo: main has no branch protection or ruleset, so GitHub enforces no required checks or reviews; whether the team's process requires an independent review anyway (memory notes a Codex review per PR) is a human decision - require_review is false per the API only.
repo: GitHub check names are the job names 'backend-api' and 'frontend'; required_ci uses per-step <job>:<step> keys because a job has no single command. Confirm that granularity is wanted.
repo: backend-api steps after blocklist-provision rely on PASSWORD_BLOCKLIST_PATH exported via $GITHUB_ENV; locally it must be set by hand (no local runner variable equivalent to $RUNNER_TEMP).

repo: frontend:visual and frontend Playwright steps need pinned Chromium 151.0.7922.34 via PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE and fonts-noto-cjk (CI installs them in setup steps); age-backup, nginx and service-unit steps need age, nginx, openssl and systemd-analyze installed.
